nodes.name: The Vaal
nodes.summary: Oldest identified civilisation of Wraeclast and in its heyday its most powerful nation; first known users of virtue gems, practitioners of mass blood sacrifice and slavery. All but 3,126 died in the Vaal Cataclysm; survivors assimilated into the Azmeri.

nodes.name: Vaal era
nodes.summary: Period of the Vaal civilisation up to the Vaal Cataclysm (c. 400 BIC).

nodes.name: Vaal first contact with the Azmeri
nodes.summary: Around 1160 BC (Trinian, writing c. 1333 IC, says about 2,500 years earlier) the Vaal first contacted the primitive Azmeri tribes of the Azmerian ranges, introducing agriculture and literacy and helping create the first Azmerian written language, while never divulging the secret of virtue gems.

chronology.relative: c. 1160 BC (~2,500 years before Chitus, per Trinian)

sources.locator: section 'Contacting the Azmeri'; Trinian, The Ancients Book 4

nodes.name: Xibaqua
nodes.summary: Mythic/historical figure of the Vaal Empire whose remains were believed to be the progenitor of all Vaal; Vaal myth says their conflict with 'the gods' produced a 'droplet of pure light', the first Vaal. Unclear whether myth or history.

nodes.name: Vaal sacrifice and Vaal souls
nodes.summary: Vaal bloodpriests discovered that the souls of the recently killed briefly seek another source of life and can be captured in a vaal skill gem to empower it; human and blood sacrifice powered Vaal constructs and society, and slavery supplied victims.

nodes.name: Virtue gems
nodes.summary: Gems discovered under Mount Veruso that the Vaal used to gain great power; Vaal bodies were adorned and later socketed with gems, and the Vaal never shared the secret with the Azmeri.

nodes.name: Vaal corruption and thaumaturgical technology
nodes.summary: Vaal science combined gem-craft, constructs, mechanical technology and corruption drawn from the Beast; much of it was developed by Doryani and housed at Atzoatl and Utzaal. Its influence resurfaces as Vaal side areas, Vaal skill gems and Vaal Orbs in PoE1.

nodes.name: Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
nodes.summary: Last Queen of the Vaal: vain, narcissistic ruler obsessed with eternal youth and beauty who demanded ever more sacrifice. Her pursuit of immortality with Doryani led to the Vaal Cataclysm; she ended trapped in a crimson nightmare realm. Boss in PoE1 (Apex of Sacrifice, Alluring Abyss/Uber, Throne of Atziri) and pinnacle boss (Atziri, the Red Queen) of PoE2's Fate of the Vaal.

nodes.name: Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge
nodes.summary: Atziri's Royal Thaumaturge ('Queen's Thaumaturgist'), the most capable and ruthless mind of her court, whose gem, technology and Beast experiments brought the Vaal prosperity and, per PoE1, ruined them; Sin calls him a 'Vaalish overreacher' who wounded the Beast. PoE2 reframes the Cataclysm as Atziri's doing: Doryani secretly opposed her communion, was captured by the Exile in Act 3 (Utzaal's past) and brought to the present as an ally seeking to contain the Beast. Claims that he built 2,000-year contingencies come only from fan analysis.

chronology.relative: c. 400 BIC; PoE2 interlude of c. 20 years after PoE1

sources.locator: The Dark Ember: 'ancient wound wrought by that Vaalish overreacher, Doryani'

nodes.name: Zerphi
nodes.summary: Vaal noble who lived to 168, a serial killer who tortured and killed thirteen noble Gemling victims over 128 years and was found rejuvenated to age twenty; his longevity prompted Atziri to order Doryani to study it.

nodes.name: Doryani's investigation of Zerphi
nodes.summary: Atziri ordered Doryani to research Zerphi's rejuvenation 'within the realms of possibility... without fear of question or consequence'; Vaal aged 16-26 were sent to him and none survived, the experiments failing.

nodes.name: Kishara
nodes.summary: Vaal explorer from Atziri's time who fell out of favour; Atziri seized her ship and sacrificed its crew. She hid Kishara's Star near the Causeway and her descendants formed the Brinerot clan.

nodes.name: Queen Tetzlapokal
nodes.summary: Pre-Atziri Vaal queen, devotee of Arakaali with a fascination with death and corpses; the Vaal City rose to prominence in her reign.

nodes.name: Jaetai, Vaal Advisor
nodes.summary: Vaal advisor to Atziri mentioned only on the flavour text of Atziri's Foible.

nodes.name: Atalui, Vaal Priestess
nodes.summary: Vaal priestess mentioned only in flavour text of Bloodseeker (not to be confused with PoE2's Atalui).

nodes.name: Ralakesh
nodes.summary: Vaal god, Master of a Million Faces, who controlled a Vaal city through 'animal instincts' and nearly caused its extinction; killed by the Exile in PoE1 Act 7.

nodes.name: Yugul
nodes.summary: Vaal scholar of fear who ascended to godhood through mirrors that 'petrify fear'; killed by the Exile in PoE1 Act 8.

nodes.name: Arakaali
nodes.summary: Spinner of Shadows: mortal temptress turned arachnid, Vaal goddess of fertility, first worshipped by the Azmeri; her temple is the Temple of Decay (Act 7).

nodes.name: Yaomac
nodes.summary: Three-headed serpent Vaal deity, shepherd of Vaal souls and arbiter of the seasons' balance.

nodes.name: Kamasa
nodes.summary: Vaal god of Wealth, represented by a monkey; in PoE2 Act 3 monkey-statue temples in Utzaal hold Kamasa treasure.

nodes.name: Kopec
nodes.summary: Vaal sun god; the Temple of Kopec in Utzaal sealed the time gateway.

sources.locator: Alva: 'Temple of the Sun God, Kopec'

nodes.name: Vaal Oversoul
nodes.summary: Giant Vaal construct and final boss of PoE1 Act 2, fought on the top floor of the Ancient Pyramid after using The Apex on the Dark Altar; Doryani's Machinarium flavour text suggests (inference) Doryani created it. Defeating it opens the way to Act 3's Sarn.

sources.locator: section 'Atziri's rule', Doryani's Machinarium flavour text

nodes.name: The Vaal Omnitect
nodes.summary: Vaal construct, boss of the present-day Temple of Atzoatl during the Incursion leagues; its exclusive currency drops come from it.

sources.locator: 'Currency' / 'Unique items': 'The Vaal Omnitect, the boss of The Temple of Atzoatl'

nodes.name: Chaos
nodes.summary: Impulse of Chaos, not a Vaal god, but a sect of Vaal priests worshipped him; his Temple of Chaos stood on the outskirts of Utzaal. The Trialmaster says Atziri's realm lies beyond his reach and the Vaal fall occurred in every timeline.

nodes.name: Vaal Cataclysm
nodes.summary: Event c. 400 BIC that ended the Vaal Empire: Doryani's project to grant immortality (manipulating the Beast, corruption, gems, sacrifice and 'communion') went wrong; only 3,126 Vaal survived and took refuge with the Azmeri. PoE2 shows the Red Communion and Atziri being swallowed by the Beast.

sources.locator: Abilities: 'cutscene... swallowed by the Beast and starting the Cataclysm'

nodes.name: The Red Communion
nodes.summary: Project that allowed Atziri to commune directly with the Beast. Doryani, privately opposed, was forced to devise it; he learned all he could and prepared contingencies. It triggered the Vaal Cataclysm.

sources.locator: Spymaster note: 'consequences of the Red Communion'

nodes.name: Atziri trapped in the crimson nightmare
nodes.summary: After the Cataclysm Atziri kept her beauty at the cost of her humanity, relegated to a nightmare realm where sacrificed Vaal rise and die repeatedly; her influence later seeps back via Vaal side areas and corruption.

nodes.name: Survivors among the Azmeri
nodes.summary: The 3,126 surviving Vaal found refuge among the Azmeri, could not explain what happened, had no gems and assimilated until none remained; they panicked at an image of a gem shown by the Kalguur.

nodes.name: Vaal survivors / Savage tribes heirs
nodes.summary: The 3,126 survivors who merged into Azmeri tribes; later Azmeri/Karui cultures inherit Vaal remnants. Descendants of Vaal blood persist (e.g. Alva Valai; the Cuachic).

sources.locator: Doryani: 'a living descendant of our people'

nodes.name: The Temple of Atzoatl
nodes.summary: Vaal temple-complex built in the last years of Atziri's reign, centre of trade, mechanical research, Chayula worship and Doryani's gem experiments; Atziri moved her seat here. PoE1 Incursion league lets players reach it 2,000 years in the past.

nodes.name: Throne of Atziri
nodes.summary: Tier-3 incursion room of Xipocado in the Temple of Atzoatl containing a boss encounter with Atziri.

nodes.name: Utzaal
nodes.summary: Vaal city, centre of Doryani's research, drowned by its own waterways at the Cataclysm to spite looters. PoE2 Act 3 setting: the Exile drains the Sunken City, then travels to its living past.

nodes.name: Aggorat
nodes.summary: Opulent Vaal district of Utzaal, known for golden tributes at its main temple's apex; in the past it holds the Black Chambers where Doryani keeps Alva. In the present the Exile reaches it via the Drowned City and the Apex of Filth, defeating the Queen of Filth for the Temple Door Idol.

nodes.name: The Black Chambers
nodes.summary: Complex within Aggorat where Doryani keeps Alva in the past of Utzaal; Act 3 boss area where the Exile captures Doryani (act boss: Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge).

nodes.name: Temple of Kopec
nodes.summary: Sealed Vaal sun-god temple beneath the Ziggurat Encampment, guarded by Ketzuli; houses the time gateway used to travel to Utzaal's past.

nodes.name: Ziggurat Encampment
nodes.summary: Treasure hunter camp built atop a ziggurat in a lake; unknowingly sits on the time gateway. Town hub of PoE2 Act 3.

nodes.name: Jiquani's Machinarium
nodes.summary: Unlooted Vaal facility in the Chimeral Wetlands holding a large Soul Core in Jiquani's Sanctum, needed to run the Matlan Waterways.

nodes.name: The Matlan Waterways
nodes.summary: Vaal canal system whose controls, powered by a large Soul Core, drain the lake to reveal Utzaal.

nodes.name: Lira Vaal / Atziri's Temple
nodes.summary: Royal temple of Atziri and Vaal capital for much of its history; rebuilt by Xipocado and Doryani as a self-reconstructing marvel. PoE2 Fate of the Vaal league lets players modify its layout.

nodes.name: Azala Vaal
nodes.summary: Vaal capital named after the burning of Lira Vaal's temple; now buried beneath Sarn where the Azmeri founded the Eternal Empire's capital.

nodes.name: Vaal Ruins (PoE2)
nodes.summary: Endgame hub in PoE2 east/north-east of the Atlas start with a waypoint and Temple Console for Atziri's Temple.

nodes.name: The Ancient Pyramid (PoE1 Act 2)
nodes.summary: Vaal pyramid in Act 2 housing the Dark Altar where the Vaal Oversoul is fought.

nodes.name: The Cradle
nodes.summary: Mirror-portal realm near the Beast where Atziri, the Fell Serpent is fought in PoE2.

nodes.name: The Apex of Sacrifice
nodes.summary: PoE1 map-device area (Sacrifice fragments) in which Atziri is fought.

nodes.name: The Alluring Abyss
nodes.summary: PoE1 area for Uber Atziri (Mortal fragments).

nodes.name: Cuachic Vault
nodes.summary: Isolated vault atop Mount Kriar where a Vaal remnant (Cuachic) lived, controlled and numbed by their High Priests.

nodes.name: Temple of Chaos (Utzaal)
nodes.summary: Temple of Vaal priests dedicated to Chaos on the outskirts of Utzaal; site of the PoE2 Trial of Chaos.

nodes.name: The Grand Architect's Temple
nodes.summary: Delve node in the Vaal Outpost biome housing the boss Ahuatotli, the Blind.

nodes.name: Ahuatotli, the Blind
nodes.summary: Vaal-themed Delve boss in The Grand Architect's Temple.

nodes.name: Incursion league
nodes.summary: PoE1 3.3.0 challenge league (June 2018) in which Alva Valai opens incursions 2,000 years into the past to the Temple of Atzoatl; later became a core Master mechanic.

nodes.name: Sacrifice of the Vaal
nodes.summary: PoE1 1.1.0 mini-expansion centred on Atziri and Vaal side areas.

nodes.name: Fate of the Vaal league
nodes.summary: PoE2 0.4.0 league (12 Dec 2025 - 25 May 2026) introducing Ancient Beacons, Atziri's Temple and the Red Queen; part of The Last of the Druids.

nodes.name: Alva Valai
nodes.summary: Treasure hunter and archaeologist of Vaal descent; PoE1 Incursion Master who creates temporal incursions into Atzoatl; PoE2 Act 3 companion at the Ziggurat Encampment whose Vaal blood activates the time gateway.

nodes.name: The Royal Architects of Atzoatl
nodes.summary: Group of Vaal architects serving Atziri who built the Temple; Incursion has Vaal Architect mini-bosses. PoE2 Medallion flavour names Architects of the Guild, Vault, Destruction, Hoard, Forge and Nexus and associates Quipolatl, Puhuarte, Juatalotli, Hayoxi, Estazunti with them.

nodes.name: Xipocado, Royal Architect
nodes.summary: Atziri's Royal Architect who with Doryani rebuilt the temple as a self-modifying machine; boss in the Temple of Atzoatl (PoE1) and Atziri's Temple (PoE2).

nodes.name: Viper Napuatzi
nodes.summary: Vaal warrior in Utzaal's past who confronts the Exile and Alva after the gate opens, accuses them of spilling Vaal blood, and has Alva taken to Doryani; defeated by the Exile in Act 3 (exact rank/title not given in the wiki quest log).

nodes.name: Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun
nodes.summary: Vaal High Priest of the Sun whose writings Alva cites about research in the Temple of Kopec (device/time gateway); boss in the Temple of Kopec defeated by the Exile in PoE2 Act 3.

nodes.name: Zolin and Zelina
nodes.summary: Cuachic Blood Priest (Zolin) and Blood Priestess (Zelina), apparently siblings and High Priests of the Cuachic Vault who kept the Cuachic numbed and controlled; defeated by the Exile in Interlude 3 and persuaded by Doryani's code phrase 'the time of the sparrow has come'.

sources.locator: 'The Cuachic Legacy' / 'The Cuachic Purpose' (writer refers to 'my sister')

nodes.name: The Cuachic
nodes.summary: Isolated Vaal remnant in Mount Kriar's vault, living under strict control for generations; recruited by Doryani's phrase in PoE2 Interlude.

nodes.name: Precursor anti-corruption weapon
nodes.summary: Ancient weapon from a lost civilisation designed against corruption; four pieces: Doryani holds one, three are scattered in Ngamakanui.

nodes.name: Utzaal time gateway
nodes.summary: Device hidden beneath the Ziggurat Encampment requiring Vaal blood that opens a gate into Utzaal's past.

nodes.name: Exile travels to Utzaal's past
nodes.summary: The Exile and Alva use the gateway to reach Utzaal before the Cataclysm to learn of the Beast.

nodes.name: Doryani captured and recruited
nodes.summary: The Exile defeats Doryani in the Black Chambers; Alva convinces him to follow them to the future and help contain the Beast.

nodes.name: Exile witnesses the Vaal Cataclysm
nodes.summary: Doryani, Alva and the Exile use the gateway as the Cataclysm begins ('It begins...'); they return to the present where Doryani sees Utzaal as a grave.

nodes.name: Recruiting the Cuachic
nodes.summary: In the Interlude the Exile reaches Mount Kriar, defeats Zolin and Zelina and secures Cuachic aid.

nodes.name: Fate of the Vaal questline
nodes.summary: League quest in which Alva and Doryani open Atziri's Temple as a time portal; the Exile defeats Xipocado, the Red Queen and Fell Serpent but fails to stop the Cataclysm.

nodes.name: Incursions into Atzoatl
nodes.summary: Alva Valai creates incursions that take the Exile 2,000 years back to the Temple of Atzoatl; changes alter the present temple.

nodes.name: Davaro of Theopolis
nodes.summary: Templar thaumaturge who heard Vaal relics 'sing', saw visions of Atziri and sacrificed Karui slaves and Oriathan children to her altar.

nodes.name: The Ancients (Trinian)
nodes.summary: In-game history by Trinian in the Library of Sarn (PoE1 Act 3), Books 1-5 on Atziri, Zerphi, Doryani, the Azmeri and the Fall.

nodes.name: Vaal Letters
nodes.summary: Twelve readable letters by victims and subjects of Atziri's regime, documenting sacrifice and dissent.

nodes.name: The Hooded One
nodes.summary: Guide figure in PoE2 who directs the Exile to the Vaal and the weapon.

nodes.name: Oswald
nodes.summary: Quartermaster of the treasure hunters at the Ziggurat Encampment.

nodes.name: Servi
nodes.summary: Local guide whose tribe knows of the Vaal ruin in the Chimeral Wetlands.

nodes.name: Zicoatl, Warden of the Core
nodes.summary: Construct guardian of the Large Soul Core in Jiquani's Sanctum.

nodes.name: Doryani's contingencies
nodes.summary: Fan-synthesised reading of Doryani's secret preparations: anti-Beast Precursor weapon, flood-sealed Utzaal, and a time gateway needing Vaal blood. Interpretive; some details rest on tertiary YouTube analysis.

nodes.name: Exile (PoE1)
nodes.summary: The PoE1 protagonist.

nodes.name: Exile (PoE2)
nodes.summary: The PoE2 protagonist.

nodes.name: The Beast
nodes.summary: Ancient divine creature of thaumaturgy, created by Sin from the Seed of Corruption; Atziri and Doryani manipulated it.

nodes.name: Azmeri
nodes.summary: Tribal people of the Azmerian ranges who took in the Vaal survivors.

nodes.name: Kalguuran
nodes.summary: Seafaring Kalguuran, shown a gem image by Vaal survivors.

nodes.name: Chayula
nodes.summary: Breachlord worshipped at Atzoatl by the Cult of Purple Flame.

nodes.name: Hinekora
nodes.summary: Karui goddess of death; could not see Doryani in the past.

nodes.name: Malachai
nodes.summary: Thaumaturge following in Doryani's footsteps.

nodes.name: High Templar Dominus
nodes.summary: Templar who brought Vaal relics to Oriath.

nodes.name: Sarn
nodes.summary: Eternal Empire capital founded on the ruins of Azala Vaal.

nodes.name: Sin
nodes.summary: God who created the Beast.

nodes.name: Ngamakanui
nodes.summary: Karui archipelago where the weapon pieces lie.

nodes.name: Karui
nodes.summary: Island people who obstructed Doryani.

nodes.name: Temple of Decay
nodes.summary: Arakaali's temple, Act 7.

nodes.name: The Vaal City
nodes.summary: Vaal city that rose to prominence under Queen Tetzlapokal; PoE1 Act 7 area.

nodes.name: The Vaal Ruins (PoE1 Act 2)
nodes.summary: Vaal ruin from which the Exile unleashes Darkness.

nodes.name: Defeat the Vaal Oversoul
nodes.summary: Exile kills the Oversoul in the Ancient Pyramid and lifts the Darkness.

nodes.name: Tacati, Architect of Toxins
nodes.summary: Unique Architect found in the Poison Garden, Cultivar Chamber and Toxic Grove rooms of the Temple of Atzoatl; his name gives the legacy Tacati item mods.

nodes.name: K'aj Y'ara'az
nodes.summary: Unique demon boss in the Vaal Temple map; one of a trio that are variants of the Atziri trio of the Apex of Sacrifice. Uses Dual Strike and Fire Enrage.

nodes.name: K'aj Q'ura
nodes.summary: Unique demon boss in the Vaal Temple map, a variant of the Atziri trio; uses Demon Cleave (Corrupted Blood) and Cyclone.

nodes.name: K'aj A'alai
nodes.summary: Third demon of the Vaal Temple map boss trio, variants of the Atziri trio; all released with Sacrifice of the Vaal.

nodes.name: Vaal Temple (map)
nodes.summary: Atlas map area themed on Vaal corruption, containing ten Vaal Vessel strongboxes and the demon boss trio; tileset similar to the Apex of Sacrifice.

nodes.name: Uber Atziri
nodes.summary: Name for Atziri when fought in the Alluring Abyss (assembled from the four Mortal fragments): mechanically the same boss as at the Apex of Sacrifice but with area modifiers that make it far harder.

nodes.name: Queen of Filth
nodes.summary: Boss in the Apex of Filth in Aggorat, Utzaal (present); the Exile defeats her to obtain the Temple Door Idol that opens the Temple of Kopec.

nodes.name: Uromoti, Architect of Expansion
nodes.summary: Vaal Architect of Atziri who, per a carving in the Howling Caves, secretly built a vault in a remote mountain, hiding the 'treason' from the Queen and sending his children into it; his name is on a Temple Console medallion. Thought the Queen mad.

nodes.name: Architects' notes in Atziri's Temple
nodes.summary: Environmental texts in Atziri's Temple: 'The Perfect Design' (Architect's living-machine temple, expecting Doryani's proxies to try to stop 'Atziri's Ascension'), 'Disloyalty' (an Architect suspects Doryani is moving against the Queen over the Red Communion) and 'The Forever Queen' (Atziri names a critic her personal Architect).

nodes.name: Xyclucian, the Chimeral
nodes.summary: Unique chimera guarding the way to Jiquani's Machinarium in the Chimeral Wetlands (PoE2 Act 3).

edges.description: The Vaal define the Vaal era.
Xibaqua is the mythic progenitor of the Vaal.
Arakaali became a Vaal goddess of fertility.
Kamasa is the Vaal god of wealth.
Ralakesh rose to prominence among the Vaal.
A sect of Vaal priests worshipped Chaos.
Cult of Purple Flame worshipped Chayula at Atzoatl.
Vaal were first known users of virtue gems.
Vaal sacrifice empowered gems and constructs.
Atziri seized Kishara's ship and sacrificed her crew.
Doryani's failed immortality research (Zerphi) preceded his larger final project; wiki implies but does not state a direct causal chain.
Atziri sent ever more Vaal to the altar.
Doryani's experiments with the Beast led to the Cataclysm.
Doryani was forced to devise it.
Doryani seeks to contain the Beast in PoE2.
Atziri moved her seat to Atzoatl.
Alva guides the Exile in incursions.
After fire Azala Vaal became capital.
Viper orders Alva brought 'to Doryani'; the wiki does not state his rank or allegiance beyond that.
In PoE2's Trial of the Ancestors dream dialogue Hinekora says 'Doryani is missing' and cannot foresee him; she foresees the Vaal Empire's fall.

sources.locator: 'Winning a Tournament in The Halls of the Dead': 'Doryani is missing... where is Doryani?'

edges.description: Malachai sought to follow in Doryani's footsteps and described him as one who 'knew the truth'; no teacher-student relationship is stated.

sources.locator: Chitus/Malachai: 'a thaumaturgist who sought to follow in Doryani's footsteps'

edges.description: Sin names Doryani's wound in the Beast.
Doryani tells Zolin and Zelina the Cuachic will march to war and meet in Kingsmarch; they call him 'Master Thaumaturge'.
Defeats Red Queen but cannot stop Cataclysm.
Tacati appears as an Architect in Temple of Atzoatl incursion rooms.
Tacati is an Architect of the Temple of Atzoatl.
Uber Atziri is the harder variant of the same boss.
Fought in the Alluring Abyss (Mortal fragments).
Optional pinnacle fight against Uber Atziri.
Released in Sacrifice of the Vaal alongside the Apex of Sacrifice and Alluring Abyss.
Defeated in the Apex of Filth for the Temple Door Idol.
Found in the Apex of Filth in Aggorat.
Her Temple Door Idol opens the Temple of Kopec.
Guardian of the road to Jiquani's Machinarium.

sources.locator: 'Currency': 'The Vaal Omnitect, the boss of The Temple of Atzoatl'

edges.description: Served Atziri while secretly building a vault out of fear of her.
'Disloyalty' references arguments with Doryani over the consequences of the Red Communion.
Architect suspects Doryani of moving against the Queen.
Same location, defined in the poe2_endgame fragment as Atziri's Temple (Lira Vaal).
Same quest as defined in poe2_endgame fragment.
Oversoul is the finale of the Shadow of the Vaal quest.

sources.locator: infobox quest = Shadow of the Vaal

edges.description: Kishara's thaumaturgical guide, hidden near the Causeway.
Recruit the Vaal is the main quest of Interlude 3 (Doryani's Contingency).
